title.zh: 建元已來王子侯者年表
title.en: Chronicle of Princes and Marquises since Jianyuan

sentences.zh: 制詔御史：「諸侯王或欲推私恩分子弟邑者，令各條上，朕且臨定其號名。」

translations.literal: Edict to the Imperial Secretary: 'When feudal kings wish to extend private favor and enfeoff younger brothers and sons with separate districts, let each present a separate memorial. I shall personally fix their titles and designations.'
translations.idiomatic: Imperial edict to the Censor-in-Chief: 'If any feudal king wishes to extend private grace by granting fiefs to his younger brothers or sons, let each submit a separate entry. I will personally determine their titles and names.'
